response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, open-source contributions, and exposure to agentic workflows at re:cinq, but lacks demonstrable production-scale multi-agent AI systems in fintech, regulatory compliance experience, and leadership scaling teams beyond 10 people — key requirements for a CTO role in high-stakes AI-driven fintech infrastructure.
strengths: Exposure to agentic AI infrastructure and MCP frameworks at re:cinq
Proven ability to build and maintain event-driven, distributed systems (GISCollective, Dunnhumby)
Strong engineering culture advocacy (TDD, CI/CD, workshops, open-source tooling)
concerns: No clear evidence of building or operating multi-agent AI systems in regulated fintech environments
Lacks documented experience scaling engineering teams from 10 to 30+ or developing senior technical leadership layers
Minimal mention of real-time inference, credit-risk systems, or financial compliance infrastructure
